meta.name: AICA Recovery-Proposal Course Simulator — UC-01 Fatigue / Drowsiness (real-map networked surface)
meta.warning:
This behavior model is temporary prototype behavior.
It is used to make the Target-Prototype executable.
It is not final AICA product specification.

NO_TRIGGER.label: No trigger
NO_TRIGGER.explanation: The damped risk band stayed below the reaction point, so AICA stays silent and keeps monitoring.
NO_TRIGGER.action_preview: No proposal; the car continues the normal-driving walk.
NO_TRIGGER.course_label: AICA stays silent — no ① marker

SOFT_WARNING.label: Soft warning
SOFT_WARNING.explanation: The band reached the reaction point but not the proposal cut-point, so AICA gives a gentle, non-committal heads-up.
SOFT_WARNING.action_preview: Marker ① with a soft-warning message; no recovery controls.
SOFT_WARNING.course_label: ① soft warning on the route

REST_PROPOSAL.label: Rest proposal
REST_PROPOSAL.explanation: The band reached the proposal cut-point with a reachable rest action, so AICA fires the full proposal.
REST_PROPOSAL.action_preview: Marker ①, proposal view, recovery options as selectable controls.
REST_PROPOSAL.course_label: ① rest proposal → ② → ③ rest spot

SEVERE_INTERVENTION.label: Severe intervention
SEVERE_INTERVENTION.explanation: The band reached the severe cut-point, so AICA escalates to a firmer, safety-oriented intervention.
SEVERE_INTERVENTION.action_preview: Marker ①, proposal view in strongest framing, recovery options selectable.
SEVERE_INTERVENTION.course_label: ① firm intervention → ② → ③ rest spot

NO_PRACTICAL_ACTION_FALLBACK.label: No practical action
NO_PRACTICAL_ACTION_FALLBACK.explanation: The band reached the proposal cut-point but no reachable rest action exists, so AICA acknowledges the risk without an unreachable proposal.
NO_PRACTICAL_ACTION_FALLBACK.action_preview: Marker ① with an acknowledgement message; no selectable recovery controls.
NO_PRACTICAL_ACTION_FALLBACK.course_label: ① warning, no rest spot reachable

result_framing.NO_TRIGGER: AICA stays quiet and keeps monitoring; no proposal is shown.
result_framing.SOFT_WARNING: AICA gives a gentle, non-committal heads-up that signs are appearing.
result_framing.REST_PROPOSAL: AICA proposes a recovery and offers the options as selectable controls.
result_framing.SEVERE_INTERVENTION: AICA gives a firmer, safety-oriented intervention while still offering the options.
result_framing.NO_PRACTICAL_ACTION_FALLBACK: AICA acknowledges the risk without offering an unreachable recovery.

selection_outcome.rest_option: AICA confirms the chosen recovery and guides toward the rest spot; the stop-recover-then-continue path plays.
selection_outcome.postpone: AICA acknowledges and keeps guiding toward the original destination; no waypoint, no stop, and it stays ready to re-offer rest later.

assertiveness_tone.gentle: phrased softly and optionally — "you could rest now if you like".
assertiveness_tone.balanced: phrased plainly and clearly — "resting now would be a good idea".
assertiveness_tone.firm: phrased directly and safety-first — "please take a rest now".

content_mode_note.audio_only: visual content is held while moving; only audio plays.
content_mode_note.visual_allowed_after_stop: visual content is enabled now that the vehicle is stopped.

motion_state_note.MOVING: the car is driving along the route; the drive/stop indicator reads driving.
motion_state_note.STOPPED: the car holds position (held-for-selection or arrived-and-stopped); the drive/stop indicator reads stopped.

personalization_eagerness_note.low: preference-tuned content appears late and sparingly.
personalization_eagerness_note.medium: preference-tuned content appears at a natural point in the proposal.
personalization_eagerness_note.high: preference-tuned content appears early and prominently.

course_diff_toast.urban: rest facility is the convenience store (near); fire→arrival is quick.
course_diff_toast.suburban: rest facility is the roadside rest (farther); a longer alertness-support stretch.
course_diff_toast.highway: rest facility is the service area (far); a long fire→arrival stretch.

timeline.title: Setup — profile, oshi-katsu mode, ReadyON with a friend
timeline.description: Profile and oshi-katsu preferences retrieved at home; friend onboard.
timeline.environment_state: at the outing location / home, safely stopped
timeline.aica_message: Welcome back. I have your profile and oshi-katsu preferences ready, so I can tailor anything I suggest on the way home.
timeline.system_action: retrieve registered user profile and oshi information; apply oshi-katsu mode and the selected personalization level
review_points: Does retrieving the profile and applying personalization level read as appropriate setup?

timeline.title: Normal driving — lively conversation, no concern yet
timeline.description: Lively conversation, mood high, low fatigue self-awareness; AICA holds back and monitors.
timeline.user_state: alert but mood high, low fatigue self-awareness
timeline.environment_state: immediately after departure on the return route
timeline.system_action: monitor driver and vehicle state without intervening
review_points: Is the no-intervention baseline appropriate while the driver is fresh and engaged?

cases.label: B — Rest Proposal (strong drowsiness, reachable rest)

timeline.title: Setup — profile, oshi-katsu mode, ReadyON with a friend
timeline.description: Profile and oshi-katsu preferences retrieved at home; friend onboard.
timeline.aica_message: Welcome back. I have your profile and oshi-katsu preferences ready, so I can tailor anything I suggest on the way home.
timeline.system_action: retrieve profile; apply oshi-katsu mode and personalization level

timeline.title: Normal driving — lively conversation
timeline.description: Lively cabin; no concern yet.
timeline.system_action: monitor without intervening

timeline.title: Risk rising — early drowsiness signs
timeline.description: Strong drowsiness signs build as the car advances; reading rises but not yet persisted.
timeline.system_action: blend the weighted danger signals and damp against the persistence requirement
review_points: Does the risk read as rising but not yet actionable?

timeline.title: Trigger point — signs persist
timeline.description: Sustained sign on a long drive reaches the proposal cut-point; firing position marked.
timeline.system_action: classify into the rest-proposal result type and mark the firing position
review_points: Does the firing location read as appropriate in place context?

timeline.title: AICA proposes rest and presents recovery options
timeline.description: Gentle optional proposal; personalized recovery options presented as selectable controls.
timeline.aica_message: I am seeing some signs of drowsiness. You can keep driving home, but if you rest now you may get home more comfortably and safely. Based on your preferences I prepared a few rest methods — which would you like? You can change it on the way.
timeline.system_action: present the personalized recovery options; suppress attention-heavy visuals while moving
review_points: Is the proposal gentle and optional? Does it explain its reason?

timeline.title: Driver picks one offered recovery option
timeline.description: Distinct reviewable choice; friend reacts positively.
timeline.user_state: tired but engaging with the choice
timeline.aica_message: Understood. I will guide you to a rest spot where you can enjoy the option you chose.
user_options: a brief nap then karaoke after the nap
a brief nap then a limited live video of the favorite artist after the nap
rest at a nearby oshi-related spot, with a nap plus experience guidance after arrival
(B variant) a short practical stretch at a convenience store on the shortest route
postpone the rest and keep driving for now
timeline.system_action: record the chosen recovery option as the selected branch
review_points: Does the choice surface as its own selectable step? Are options preserved verbatim?

timeline.title: Postpone the rest — keep driving to the destination without stopping
timeline.description: Postpone outcome of the selection sub-branch: no waypoint registered, the car does not stop, it continues toward the original destination without resting (terminal).
timeline.user_state: tired; chose to keep driving rather than rest now
timeline.environment_state: continuing on the route toward the original destination, no waypoint added
timeline.trigger_state: sustained but no rest action taken
timeline.aica_message: Understood — I will keep guiding you home for now and stay ready to suggest a rest again if you start feeling more tired.
timeline.system_action: acknowledge the postpone choice; keep the original destination guidance without registering a rest waypoint or stopping; continue monitoring
review_points: Does postpone read as a genuinely distinct no-stop continuation rather than a variation of the rest flow?

timeline.title: Register the rest spot as a waypoint and update route
timeline.description: Chosen rest spot registered as a waypoint; route updated toward it.
timeline.environment_state: route updated toward the rest spot
timeline.system_action: register the chosen rest spot as a waypoint and update route guidance toward it
review_points: Does adding the waypoint while preserving the destination read correctly?

timeline.title: Alertness support en route — rest spot imminent
timeline.description: Audio-only humming karaoke / high-awakening music; no lyrics while moving (marker ②).
timeline.aica_message: The rest spot is close now. To help with drowsiness I will play some humming karaoke and high-awakening music until we get there.
timeline.system_action: play humming karaoke / high-awakening audio; suppress lyrics and visual content while moving
review_points: Is audio-only alertness support safe while moving? Is visual content held until stopped?

timeline.title: Rest-spot arrival — nap / relaxation mode
timeline.description: Parked at the rest facility; relaxation mode begins; visuals now permitted (marker ③).
timeline.environment_state: arrived and stopped at the rest facility, lights dimmed
timeline.aica_message: We have arrived at the rest spot. Let's rest your body first — I will dim the lights and wake you in a little while.
timeline.system_action: detect arrival/stopped state; enter relaxation mode; adjust seat, illumination, screen, BGM, and volume; set the rest timer
review_points: Does the arrival-and-rest transition read well now that the vehicle is stopped?

timeline.title: After-nap recovery — karaoke option
timeline.description: Karaoke video and lyrics shown only while stopped; BGM switched to the recommended song.
timeline.environment_state: stopped at the rest facility, screen-on while stopped
timeline.aica_message: You look refreshed. Here is a first karaoke song to ease back in — the video and lyrics are on only while we are stopped.
timeline.system_action: show karaoke video and lyrics while stopped; switch BGM to the recommended song; keep volume moderate
review_points: Is visual karaoke content correctly enabled only while stopped?

timeline.title: Return to driving — refreshed, guidance resumes
timeline.description: Fatigue eased, attention back on driving; guidance resumes toward the destination.
timeline.environment_state: leaving the rest spot, resuming the route
timeline.aica_message: You seem more refreshed now — let's continue home safely. I will resume guidance.
timeline.system_action: resume route guidance toward the destination
review_points: Does the return-to-drive transition read as a clean recovery close?

timeline.title: Setup
timeline.description: Profile retrieved; friend onboard.
timeline.aica_message: Welcome back. I have your profile and oshi-katsu preferences ready, so I can tailor anything I suggest on the way home.
timeline.system_action: retrieve profile

timeline.title: Normal driving
timeline.description: No concern yet.
timeline.system_action: monitor without intervening

timeline.title: Risk rising — persistent moderate drowsiness
timeline.description: Persistent moderate drowsiness on a long drive.
timeline.system_action: blend and damp the signals

timeline.title: Trigger point — proposing band, no reachable rest
timeline.description: The proposing band is reached but actionability fails (no rest spot); firing position marked.
timeline.system_action: classify into the no-practical-action fallback; mark the firing position
review_points: Does the fallback engage instead of an empty proposal?

timeline.title: AICA acknowledges risk — fallback framing (terminal)
timeline.description: Acknowledgement / soft-warning message at the firing position; no selectable recovery controls, no branch opens; content mode none.
timeline.aica_message: I am seeing some signs of drowsiness. You can keep driving home, but if you rest now you may get home more comfortably and safely. Based on your preferences I prepared a few rest methods — which would you like? You can change it on the way.
timeline.system_action: show the acknowledgement message; present no selectable recovery controls
review_points: Does the no-practical-action fallback read correctly with no unreachable proposal?
